Let me know by EOD if you need alternative room assignments or if any requested items are unavailable. Thanks — Carla, if you want me to tweak the file for room adjacency constraints I can do that this afternoon.

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the files — received and reviewed. A few quick notes from the venue operations team: 

- Quiet corridor: We can allocate Suites 1502, 1504, 1506 and 1508 on the 15th floor as a quiet pod; we will log no-entry early-morning housekeeping and add a do-not-disturb flag for 1502/1504 (these are the VP rooms). No extra charge.
- Hypoallergenic bedding and mattress toppers: Available. Small service fee applies for topper provision (listed on attached vendor addendum). If you prefer we can waive the fee with a minimum of two additional room upgrades (negotiable).
- White-noise machines & blackout curtains: Blackout curtains are standard in suites; we have a limited number of travel white-noise units — we can reserve four.
- Early check-in / late checkout: Early check-in at 07:30 will be on request; we recommend a guaranteed early check-in for the lead via room-ready notification. Late checkout for two rooms to 15:00 is approved; a nominal late-checkout fee applies unless rooms are on the master bill and cleared.

I attached the vendor addendum and the preliminary rooming map (we'll insert your spreadsheet into the hotel map to confirm adjacency). Two questions for your team: 

1) Which guest(s) require hypoallergenic pillows vs full bedding replacement? The CSV lists preferences but they're grouped by party — we need per-room clarity to order replacement sets on time.
2) Please confirm which two rooms (if any) you'd like to upgrade to meet the waiver threshold for toppers.

We aim to lock final room assignments by Wednesday COB to ensure housekeeping and supply routing.

Regards,
Maya Patel

2) Topper waiver: Please waive the service fee; we will upgrade two additional rooms (1510 and 1512) to premium king to hit your minimum. Confirm those upgrades are possible and include any rate delta on the master bill.

- Early check-in: the lead arriving 07:30 is Carla Reyes (carla@acmeanalytics.com). If the room can't be ready before 09:00 please hold a work area in your business center with secure bag drop; we will instruct the guest.
